question: Which of the following factors is responsible for the disease called 'Mad Hatter Disease'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mercury Toxicity**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mercury Toxicity is responsible for the disease called 'Mad Hatter Disease'**__.

 __
 
• **Mad hatter's disease **is a form of mercury poisoning that affects the brain and nervous system.
 
• People can develop mercury poisoning by inhaling mercury vapours.
 
• Mad hatter's disease is caused by chronic mercury poisoning.
 
• It is characterized by emotional, mental, and behavioural changes, among other symptoms.
